_note: The KINP `model` entities pinakes has minted for the base models its ml/ pipeline fine-tunes, each carrying the external anchor to its Hugging Face coordinate (KFT 0.3.0 §5.1, FT-G). A finetune-job names the ENTITY id; pinakes_ml.kft resolves it here. An `hf:...` string in a job is not a base model — it is an unanchored guess. Add a row before pointing a config at a new base; ml/tests/test_kft.py asserts every committed slm-pilot config's base_model is anchored.
